audit.reasoning: Coding fixed-strict final (final stress) is correct and now triply supported: (i) deciding quote Miyakoshi 2006:51-52, 58 confirmed verbatim in the PDF (previously only in scratch, now saved to our files); (ii) Matisoff 2003:11 confirmed in held scanned; (iii) the best first-hand source, Phillips 2013 SIL ESR 2013-010 (held), states on p.6 and again App. F p.88 'Semai words always have ultimate stress; that is, on the major syllable', p.36 'normally only the ultimate syllable bears stress' (sole exception: full reduplication with both copies stressed). the StressTyp2 entry for this language and Gordon 2002 agree (final).
